headline: Wedding Season Guest Successfully Sells Ad Space On His Traditional Ethnic Wear To Recover Travel Expenses
body: A software engineer attending his cousin’s wedding in Udaipur has successfully brokered a deal with a local mattress brand to plaster a QR code across his sherwani’s back panel, effectively covering his flight and hotel costs. The attendee confirmed that guests are now required to scan his shoulder blades to access the couple’s digital wedding album.
caption: When the shaadi budget hits rock bottom, corporate sponsorship is the only way out. Would you wear a brand logo to your best friend's reception if it meant a free hotel stay? #ShaadiSeason #CorporateHumor #DesiWeddings (satire)
igHook: Tag a friend who would totally monetize their wedding outfit to pay for the buffet.
